To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the amount of consciousness that a system has is proportional to the quantity of information that it can integrate; (2) the quality of consciousness of a system is determined by the way that it integrates information; (3) the value of a particular conscious experience is determined by the values of the information variables mediating the integration of information in the system; (4) the information integration theory accounts for the neurobiology of consciousness; (5) the information integration approach to consciousness can be applied
consciousness is a property of complex systems that is determined by the quantity and quality of information that is integrated in the system.
consciousness is the information that integrates one or more elements into one or more unified experiences.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nature of consciousness and its neural basis.
the nature and the neural basis of conscious experience.

developing a theory about what it is for a physical system to be conscious, with specifying a method of quantifying the amount of consciousness available to such a system, and with using this method to test hypotheses about the neural correlates of consciousness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the theory of consciousness is a theory about what it is to be conscious.
the theory of consciousness presented here is the first one that can explain all the main properties of consciousness and that can be tested in the neurosciences.
consciousness is the effective integration of information across the elements of a system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a theory of consciousness that is grounded in the neurobiology of information processing and is capable of making testable predictions about the neurophysiological basis of conscious experience.
we propose a new definition of consciousness and a new measure of consciousness that is based on information theory, and that the new definition and measure can explain many aspects of consciousness.
the information integration theory provides a framework for the study of consciousness and its relationship to the brain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a theory of consciousness is possible and that it can be tested by neurobiological experiments.
consciousness is a physical quantity, which can be measured, just as energy can be measured.
consciousness is a property of the brain that is associated with the capacity of a brain to integrate information, and that it is possible to quantify consciousness.
